item_name: Nutritional Approaches — Feeding tube (nasogastric or abdominal (PEG))

lookback_source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: Column 2 and Column 3 use a 7-day look-back period (Column 2 = performed prior to admission/entry or reentry and within the last 7 days; Column 3 = performed after admission/entry or reentry and within the last 7 days). Other windows apply to the other columns: Column 1 covers the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay (item table: "Assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B") and Column 4 covers the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ("Assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C"). The manual does not state how the 7-day window is counted relative to the ARD for this item.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed prior to admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period. Leave Column 2 blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

federal_coding_rules.rule: K0520B is the feeding tube item — nasogastric or abdominal (PEG); check all that apply across the applicable columns.

source.quote: K0520B, feeding tube – nasogastric or abdominal (PEG).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Only feeding tubes that are used to deliver nutritive substances and/or hydration during the assessment period are coded in K0520B.

source.quote: Only feeding tubes that are used to deliver nutritive substances and/or hydration during the assessment period are coded in K0520B.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Review the medical record to determine if any of the listed nutritional approaches were performed during the look-back period; if none apply, check K0520Z.

source.quote: Review the medical record to determine if any of the listed nutritional approaches were performed during the look-back period.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column 2 is left blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

source.quote: Leave Column 2 blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A feeding tube is the presence of any type of tube that can deliver food/nutritional substances/fluids directly into the gastrointestinal system (e.g., nasogastric, gastrostomy, jejunostomy, PEG tubes).

source.quote: FEEDING TUBE Presence of any type of tube that can deliver food/ nutritional substances/ fluids directly into the gastrointestinal system.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Enteral feeding formulas should not be coded as a mechanically altered diet; they should only be coded as K0520D, Therapeutic Diet, when the enteral formula is altered to manage problematic health conditions.

source.quote: Enteral feeding formulas: — Should not be coded as a mechanically altered diet.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

source.quote: Complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

federal.criterion: Medical record review is the assessment source for determining whether the nutritional approach (feeding tube) was performed during the look-back period.

source.quote: Review the medical record to determine if any of the listed nutritional approaches were performed during the look-back period.

federal.notes: Stated as the step for assessment for K0520.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The manual ties K0520B columns to the SNF PPS Stay assessment periods and requires K0520B completion on the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), a payment assessment; no explicit case-mix group assignment is stated on these pages.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

conflicts.topic: Multiple observation windows coexist for K0520B columns (7-day look-back vs. 3-day SNF PPS Stay periods)

positions.claim: Columns 2 and 3 use a 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

positions.claim: Column 1 uses the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay and Column 4 uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed during the first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

conflicts.resolution: Not a contradiction: the document assigns different windows to different columns of the same item. Recorded here because more than one window applies; lookback_days reflects the 7-day column 2/3 window.
